Document contains the school/department-wise mapping of all programmes offered by the university, including programme name, academic level (UG, PG, Diploma, Certificate, Integrated), and type (Regular, Lateral Entry, New, Integrated), organized across all schools; covers School of Engineering & Technology, School of Life Sciences & Biotechnology, School of Basic Sciences, School of Health Sciences, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, School of Languages, School of Legal Studies, School of Hospitality, School of Creative & Performing Arts, School of Teacher Education, School of Arts Humanities & Social Sciences, School of Business Management, and School of Advanced Agriculture Sciences & Technology; relevant queries include which school offers a specific programme, what UG/PG courses are available in a given department, which programmes are newly introduced, which schools offer lateral entry or integrated programmes, and how courses are categorized by level across the university; domain: university academic structure and programme-to-department directory.
